status: proposed scientific schedule; not a frozen execution registration
extends: protocol-002.json evidence, grounding and source-binding contracts; earlier protocols/results remain immutable
question: Does accumulated verified workflow knowledge improve unseen-task capability and the total quality-cost frontier of native Codex agents?

basis.adaptation: RSI-inspired; autonomous native Codex assignments instead of the paper's mini-SWE-agent per-action controller
basis.official_rsi_code: not located in current source review; no claim to reuse an official implementation
basis.small_extension: recency-aware selection of applicable verified experience

primary_benchmark.name: SWE-bench Verified
primary_benchmark.selection: Freeze metadata-based order, prior-exposure audit and issue/fix/base-lineage exclusions before construction; cross-repository transfer requires a separate split.
primary_benchmark.evaluator: official prescribed evaluator; exact source/image pins and pristine empty/reference controls pending

knowledge.interpretation: source-bound Luna interprets public traces; host-verified support and executor attribution required
knowledge.teacher_rule: Sol procedures may ground Luna but contribute zero observed Luna successes.
knowledge.failure_rule: Retain failures; a failed parent can supply verified local lessons only with explicit outcome scope.
knowledge.snapshot_rule: Nested immutable prefixes count all construction tasks, not only successes; publish eligible procedure and parent counts including zero.
knowledge.no_hidden_material: No hidden evaluator feedback, test patch or evaluated solution enters runtime knowledge.

system_families: native Sol primary with Luna delegation tool
primary_matrix.equal_information: Every family has the same eligible snapshot and packet limits; log actual retrieved context.
primary_matrix.resource_control: Freeze tools, model/effort, actor, context policy and positive finite parent caps; primary/worker work shares those caps.
primary_matrix.policy_selection: Select routed policy on development only; freeze all cells before first test call.
primary_matrix.launch: Forecast only; feasibility and complete finite stage budgets must be resolved before launching the heldout matrix.

secondary_recency.controls: Same scope/library, packet order/budget and actor contracts. Development-select similarity coverage control. Neither condition receives hidden feedback.
secondary_recency.age: Verified execution timestamps; never import timestamps or fabricated aging.
secondary_recency.gate: Natural age variation and eligible support required; otherwise report recency effect unidentifiable.

secondary_benchmark.name: Terminal-Bench coding/build/debug subset
secondary_benchmark.policy: Register after primary qualification; pin paper version 2.0 or explicitly label 2.1 adaptation, exclude corresponding task versions and report separately.

comparative_router_suite.status: required comparative extension; exact implementation/assignment freeze pending
simple_baselines: seeded task-level random and endpoint mixture envelope
Luna-first public-check cascade with shared caps
comparative_router_suite.released_task_router_candidate: RouteLLM actual method, trained/calibrated on disjoint Luna/Sol development observations; compatible reviewed local adapter required
comparative_router_suite.selection: Resolve runnable implementations and register adaptations before test; missing baselines limit claims and cannot silently disappear.
comparative_router_suite.fairness: Same model pair, knowledge access, public tools/checks, evaluator and total caps; include baseline training/selection/inference costs.
comparative_router_suite.operating_point_rule: Select using development only and freeze before test; retain duplicate/infeasible points.
comparative_router_suite.frontier: Compare union of baseline points and endpoint mixture envelope with paired uncertainty and preregistered selection/multiplicity rules. Non-dominance is local to evaluated systems/tasks, not global optimality.
comparative_router_suite.budget_note: 384 covers core accumulation matrix only. Additional baseline, operating-point and ablation assignments require a complete finite manifest before any heldout inference.

novelty.prior_art: RSI already combines accumulated experience, model-specific skills and Pareto selection; SkillOrchestra already models skill-conditioned agent competence.
not_claimed: new algorithm from substituting Luna/Sol or Codex
novelty.candidate_contribution: Controlled knowledge-size transfer curves with equal-information standalone and router comparisons, recency ablation, cache/handoff accounting and construction amortization.
novelty.claim_boundary: Replication plus empirical extension until supported by broader literature comparison and heldout mechanism/transfer evidence.

leakage_controls.evaluation: Frozen-prefix paired transfer; not chronological online learning.
leakage_controls.test_feedback: Seal all test grades until all predeclared cells finish; never tune or publish heldout traces into construction knowledge.
leakage_controls.duplicates: Exclude same issue/fix/base lineage, source aliases and prior exposed solutions; retain exclusions with provenance.
leakage_controls.future_online_phase: Separate registration: arm-owned earlier public experience only, publication watermarks, fixed stream, no future or cross-arm memory, hidden grading sealed.

primary: total model resources per assigned task
measurement.accounting: Include primary, worker, annotation, extraction, checking, retrieval, failure and integration resources; distinguish non-inference host work.
measurement.cost_labels: Native token/cache counters, provider estimates, rate scenarios and subscription cash are separate. Missing values stay unknown.
measurement.interpretation: 32 tasks and one repeat are exploratory; no guaranteed new frontier, tight noninferiority or direct innovation-originality claim.

implementation_status.existing: Typed routing, versioned grounding and MCP/native adapter software; 30 focused tests recorded separately. This is not native quality evidence.
